layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of prehistoric desert dune fields
features: Giant rolling dunes of orange-red sand with wind-sculpted ripples
Hardy, low-lying xerophytic ferns in the sheltered dune valleys
Clumps of squat, tough Cycads with leathery leaves
Pale sandstone outcrops jutting through the sand
Brilliant white sun casting high-contrast shadows
layer_3_action.action: A wide, bright view of an expansive desert at noon, emphasizing the vibrant oranges of the sand and the cloudless turquoise sky.

visuals.ground: Deeply textured orange-gold sand with intricate ripple patterns. Tiny, tough ferns and Cycads are tucked into the swales. Absolutely no grass.
visuals.sky: Bright, clear turquoise sky; cloudless and vast. The sun is a brilliant white circle directly overhead.
visuals.atmosphere: Dry, hot, and crystal clear; slight heat shimmer on the distant horizon.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Loose, fine-grained sand and parched, wind-eroded sandstone.

negative_prompt: grass, green fields, forests, water, rain, gloom, clouds, 90s CGI, grainy, humans, buildings
